payload.name: Word Segmentation Cues
payload.fact: The utility of explicit word boundary cues in traditional Chinese script is specific to readers with lower vocabulary knowledge and words with clear, unambiguous boundaries.

provenance.title: Reading fluency and word segmentation agreement modulate the benefits of word boundary cues for older readers in traditional Chinese
provenance.quote_or_locus: benefits of word segmentation cues were strikingly specific, emerging only for readers with lower vocabulary knowledge and for words with clear, unambiguous boundaries
